title: Selling Plans — Performance Standing Relief on Term Change Fees
content:
The term change fee charged when a **Selling Plans** store moves from the annual to the monthly term is relieved for sellers in good standing. The relief reads two items of the seller's Seller Performance Standing record: the current performance level and the active violation points.

**Rule.** The standing relief of a term change fee is the top standing relief when the seller's performance level is one of the discount standing levels and the standing record shows no active violation points, the above standing relief when the level is Above Standard Level and no active violation points are shown, and nothing otherwise.

The discount standing levels are Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level.

A relief is taken from the repayment share of the term change fee: the reliefs that apply are added together first and the total is taken from one once.

## Truth table

| Performance level | Active violation points | Standing relief |
|---|---|---|
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | None (zero) | 20% (top standing relief) |
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | One or more | None |
| Above Standard Level | None (zero) | 10% (above standing relief) |
| Above Standard Level | One or more | None |
| Standard Level, Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level | Any | None |

## Cases (hypothetical standing records)

- Preferred Partner Level, 0 points → 20%.
- Top Rated Level, 2 active points → no standing relief.
- Above Standard Level, 0 points → 10%.
